title: Flight deck — final layout
question: Approve a layout for the full frontend rebuild, or leave a note to combine or revise it. The implementation will retain all existing content and media; illustrative project thumbnails and inaccurate placeholder wording will use your real assets and descriptions.

options.label: Split composition — recommended
options.thesis: Large stacked name beside the optical instrument, with introduction and actions immediately readable.
options.viewport: A clear left-hand introduction and a dominant right-hand glass instrument; work begins just below.
options.risk: The optical instrument needs careful responsive sizing.

options.label: Full-width nameplate
options.thesis: The name becomes the largest architectural element, with an overlapping optical form and compact work index.
options.viewport: A single-line masthead followed by role and actions on the left, instrument on the right, and project rows below.
options.risk: The name must transition to a stacked arrangement on smaller screens.

options.label: Instrument workspace
options.thesis: The glass instrument leads the composition, with a dedicated information and navigation rail.
options.viewport: A large optical field and overlaid name to the left; role, introduction, actions and disciplines in a right-hand column.
options.risk: The narrower text column gives the introduction less breathing room.
